fixes.problem: Supporting text is repeatedly faint in hercule-orient-express-wiki-1x.png (300, 177, 507, 418), hercule-orient-express-workflows-1x.png (1294, 139, 120, 746), hercule-whitehaven-conversation-1x.png (21, 343, 234, 346), and hercule-whitehaven-draft-1x.png (521, 488, 664, 15).
fixes.change: Set secondary text ink to oklch(0.70 0.018 65) in Orient Express and oklch(0.52 0.012 80) in Whitehaven, at opacity 1. Verify at least 4.5:1 contrast for summaries, timestamps, workspace labels and supporting state text against their actual backgrounds.

fixes.problem: Small supporting roles repeat in hercule-orient-express-wiki-1x.png (300, 177, 507, 418), hercule-orient-express-workflows-1x.png (570, 139, 844, 259), and hercule-whitehaven-conversation-1x.png (1204, 404, 35, 163).
fixes.change: Use font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400 as the minimum supporting-text role for page summaries, trigger metadata, percentages and timestamps.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-conversation-1x.png (522, 275, 716, 59) and (522, 614, 716, 37): assistant prose repeatedly approaches or exceeds 100 characters per line.
fixes.change: Set assistant prose max-inline-size to 64ch and line-height to 22px. Measure the rendered result against the 60–75-character target.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-workflows-1x.png (748, 267, 219, 131): history checks and crosses are too small to distinguish reliably by shape at 1x.
fixes.change: Render history marks at 12×12px with 2px strokes. Arrange the 20 marks in two rows of ten with 4px horizontal and vertical gaps, filling left-to-right with the older row first. The group occupies 156×28px within a 40px table row.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-workflows-1x.png (589, 265, 151, 620): Starts on repeatedly displays raw event keys instead of plain event names.
fixes.change: Display github.issue.opened as 'GitHub issue opened', github.issue.labeled as 'GitHub issue labeled', github.issue.assigned as 'GitHub issue assigned', github.pr.opened as 'GitHub pull request opened', github.pr.merged as 'GitHub pull request merged', github.issue.closed as 'GitHub issue closed', and run.failed as 'Run failed'. Allow two lines at 12px/16px within the 40px row.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-draft-1x.png (628, 331, 461, 17) and (650, 488, 112, 15): setup guidance uses worktree and remote default terminology without plainly explaining the result.
fixes.change: Replace the guidance with 'The agent starts in a new workspace, on a branch from the repository’s default branch.' Replace the branch-row label 'remote default' with 'Repository default branch'.

fixes.problem: hercule-orient-express-wiki-1x.png (1128, 272, 110, 16): 'run 4f2a91c0' exposes an identifier without identifying the workflow responsible for the change.
fixes.change: Use the owning workflow's display name followed by ' · run' as the primary provenance label. Put 'Run 4f2a91c0' on a secondary line at 12px font-size and 16px line-height.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-conversation-1x.png (621, 153, 487, 34): the interruption notice repeats failure information and uses cumbersome provider terminology.
fixes.change: Replace the notice with 'Ada’s turn timed out after 120 seconds. Your message was kept.'

summary: Hercule retains its warm surfaces and expressive crew identity, with clear primary content. Small metadata, wide conversation lines and tiny workflow history marks remain visible weaknesses. The calibration captures show how hard white text and borders can flatten hierarchy and tire the eye.
